g.text: Gambit modern C: one semantic contract across control, GC/SMP and builds

text.tspan: Closed semantic plan and ordered module
C ABI, trampoline and exact layout adapters
Epoch-bound root slots and scan grants with
Admitted host entry, block transition and
Accepted task custody and exactly owned
Finite / conditional checks; whole source and native OPEN
Fails if duplicated layout decisions remain or
Fails if native-only edits unnecessarily redo
expansion or semantic edits incorrectly hit old
Fails on any missed mature-to-young writer,
unrooted native alias, or shared mutable
Fails when saved work does not exceed added
